rules.summary: The claim declares the standard revision it is graded against.
rules.forecloses: grading an artifact against rules it was never written for

rules.summary: evidence_class is one of measured, simulated, mixed.
rules.forecloses: a modelled number being read as a measured one

rules.summary: A simulated or mixed claim states what was modelled and what measured.
rules.forecloses: an unexplained simulation passing as evidence

rules.summary: A loss column is present.
rules.forecloses: selective reporting

rules.summary: If any cell lost, at least one region describes where.
rules.forecloses: acknowledging losses without locating them

rules.summary: The column does not declare itself incomplete.
rules.forecloses: publishing a column known to be partial

rules.summary: The column is in the main body, not an appendix.
rules.forecloses: burying adverse regimes

rules.summary: Every loss region carries an attributed cause.
rules.forecloses: a location without a mechanism

rules.summary: Cells that could not be measured are accounted for.
rules.forecloses: an out-of-memory regime vanishing from the record

rules.summary: The inconclusive fraction is stated and tolerable.
rules.forecloses: an underdetermined envelope reading as a settled one

rules.summary: The design is capable of declaring a loss if one exists.
rules.forecloses: an empty loss column produced by an underpowered sweep

rules.summary: Every region's statistical support meets the claim's own thresholds.
rules.forecloses: a region asserted as a loss on evidence weaker than the claim declares

rules.summary: A tuned comparison ships a parity certificate.
rules.forecloses: the untuned baseline

rules.summary: The parity certificate reports no violation.
rules.forecloses: a comparison known to be unfair

rules.summary: At least two systems were tuned under the budget.
rules.forecloses: calling a single-system measurement a comparison

rules.summary: Trial counts are equal across systems.
rules.forecloses: unequal effort presented as equal

rules.summary: No system was still improving when its budget ended.
rules.forecloses: a lower bound reported as an optimum

rules.summary: The operators of record are named.
rules.forecloses: an undocumented skill confound

rules.summary: The baseline was tuned, or derives from systems that were.
rules.forecloses: the untuned baseline, in its most direct form

rules.summary: The declared tuning state of each arm matches its ledger.
rules.forecloses: a tuned configuration presented as library defaults

rules.summary: At least two factors were swept.
rules.forecloses: a point estimate supporting a general claim

rules.summary: The envelope meets the minimum cell count.
rules.forecloses: a surface asserted from too few samples

rules.summary: The headline reports best, worst and median.
rules.forecloses: a single number as a headline

rules.summary: The headline range is non-degenerate.
rules.forecloses: a point estimate dressed as a range

rules.summary: The worst case names the conditions that produce it.
rules.forecloses: an unlocatable worst case

rules.summary: The headline avoids unbounded superlatives.
rules.forecloses: 'up to 2x faster'

rules.summary: The headline's extremes are consistent with the loss column.
rules.forecloses: a summary the artifact's own measurements do not support

rules.summary: A pre-registration document is present.
rules.forecloses: post-hoc selection of the favourable comparison

rules.summary: The protocol was sealed.
rules.forecloses: a protocol written after the data

rules.summary: The normative fields still hash to the seal.
rules.forecloses: editing the protocol after sealing

rules.summary: The results were verified against the protocol.
rules.forecloses: a seal nobody checked

rules.summary: No fatal protocol deviation was found.
rules.forecloses: analysing under different parameters than were registered

rules.summary: No deviation from the sealed protocol was declared.
rules.forecloses: undisclosed drift from the plan

rules.summary: The seal carries an external anchor.
rules.forecloses: ordering resting on the author's own clock

rules.summary: A reproduction command is given.
rules.forecloses: unfalsifiability by inaccessibility

rules.summary: Reproduction is one command, not a pipeline.
rules.forecloses: a recipe only its author can follow

rules.summary: A commit is pinned.
rules.forecloses: an unversioned result

rules.summary: The producing source tree was clean.
rules.forecloses: a pinned commit that does not identify the code that ran

rules.summary: A container image is pinned.
rules.forecloses: an irreproducible software environment

rules.summary: The hardware is documented.
rules.forecloses: a result that cannot be situated

rules.summary: A runtime estimate is given.
rules.forecloses: a reproducer unable to budget for the attempt

rules.summary: Feasibility is a state, never a sentinel value.
rules.forecloses: an out-of-memory configuration encoded as a throughput of zero, which comparison paths then skip

rules.summary: A cell that did not run carries no measurement.
rules.forecloses: 'did not run' and 'ran and measured zero' collapsing into one number

rules.summary: A completed run served from host memory is not device-feasible.
rules.forecloses: a run that thrashes for hours being recorded as fitting

rules.summary: Calibration and validation data are disjoint and the split is recorded.
rules.forecloses: a model graded on the data that chose its parameters

rules.summary: No parameter is fitted after the model is frozen.
rules.forecloses: a validation set quietly becoming a training set

rules.summary: A parameter that failed its quality gate is not used.
rules.forecloses: a rejected fit promoted into an active model because nobody re-read its provenance

rules.summary: A fit over a log-scaled domain reports per-regime error, not only a pooled figure.
rules.forecloses: one useless regime hiding behind three good ones, and R^2 dominated by the largest points

rules.summary: Replicate count meets the floor.
rules.forecloses: an underpowered design

rules.summary: Measurements were interleaved.
rules.forecloses: drift confounded with the effect

rules.summary: Per-system cell coverage is high.
rules.forecloses: a sparse envelope described as full

rules.summary: Measurement noise is small relative to the claimed effect.
rules.forecloses: an effect indistinguishable from the noise floor

rules.summary: Limitations are stated.
rules.forecloses: a claim presented without its bounds

rules.summary: Equivalence is established somewhere when the design has the power to.
rules.forecloses: an inverted or broken equivalence test, which makes every tie look inconclusive
